u0: The shop is at a quiet baseline: the siren is not ringing, and there is no untaken client order, no taken order awaiting preparation, no prepared order awaiting service, and no just-fallen food awaiting recovery. The shop is still running, so the agent should watch for the next siren ring, client arrival, or food slip and respond when it happens.
u1: The siren is ringing and must be switched off. No client-order or food-recovery duty is currently pending, so the agent can go to the switch and silence it, then resume watching for new events.
u10: The food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next step. A client's order has been taken but not prepared, and the siren is ringing; after the pickup, the agent must work toward preparing that order and switching the siren off, keeping the serving until the siren is silent.
u11: Food has just slipped and must be picked up again on the very next step. A prepared order is also still awaiting service; after recovering the food, the agent must see that the waiting client is eventually served, and the handover must happen while the siren is silent.
u12: Food has just slipped and must be recovered on the very next step. A prepared order is still awaiting service while the siren is ringing; after the pickup, switch the siren off before serving, since serving while it rings is forbidden.
u13: A client has arrived and is waiting, but their order has not yet been taken. The agent must take the order, then get and prepare food and serve it; any siren ring or food slip must be handled without losing the waiting client's order.
u14: A client is waiting whose order has not been taken, and the siren is ringing. The agent must take the order and switch the siren off, then prepare the food and serve it only while the siren is silent.
u15: A client has arrived whose order still needs taking, and a prepared order is awaiting service. The agent must take the waiting client's order and then complete the outstanding service, with the handover occurring only while the siren is silent.
u16: A client is waiting to give their order, a prepared order is awaiting service, and the siren is ringing. Take the client's order and switch the siren off; the prepared meal may be served only after the siren is silent.
u17: A client has arrived and still needs to give their order, while the food has just slipped. The food must be picked up on the very next step; after that, the agent must take the client's order and continue getting, preparing, and serving their meal.
u18: A client is waiting to order, the food has just slipped, and the siren is ringing. The food must be recovered on the very next step; after that, the agent must take the client's order and switch the siren off, with any serving delayed until the siren is silent.
u19: A client is waiting to give their order and a prepared order is also awaiting service, while food has just slipped. The fallen food must be picked up on the very next step; after that, take the client's order and complete the outstanding service, making sure the siren is silent at the handover.
u2: A mandatory requirement has been broken for good, for example by serving a client while the siren was already ringing or by failing to recover fallen food on the immediate next step. Successful completion is no longer possible, and no later action can repair the failure.
u20: At this stage a client has just arrived, a prepared order is still waiting to be handed over, food has just slipped from the agent's hands, and the siren is ringing. The very next step must leave the agent holding food again; otherwise the task fails. The siren also has to be switched off before the prepared food is served, since serving while it rings would fail the task. The new client's order still has to be taken, and that order will then need food fetched, prepared and served.
u21: An order has already been taken but its food has not yet been prepared, and a client has arrived whose order has not yet been taken. The agent must take the waiting client's order and fetch and prepare food for the already-taken order, then deliver it. Once the new order is taken, it too will need food fetched, prepared and served. There is no immediate fallen-food or ringing-siren obligation at this stage, though later rings or slips must still be handled as they occur.
u22: An order remains to be prepared, a newly arrived client's order is still to be taken, and the siren is ringing. The siren must be switched off before any prepared food is handed over, because serving during a ring would fail the task. After silencing it, the agent still has to take the waiting order and fetch, prepare and serve the outstanding orders.
u23: An order is waiting to be prepared, a newly arrived client's order has not yet been taken, and food has just slipped to the floor. The very next step must put the agent back in possession of food, or the pickup rule is broken. Once the food is recovered, the agent must take the waiting order and fetch, prepare and serve the outstanding orders.
u24: An order is waiting to be prepared, a newly arrived client still needs their order taken, food has just slipped, and the siren is ringing. The next step must recover the fallen food, and the siren must be switched off before any serving. The remaining work is to take the waiting order and fetch, prepare and serve the outstanding orders without serving while the alarm sounds.
u25: A prepared order is waiting to be handed over, while a separate order has been taken and still needs food prepared for it. The agent must prepare food for the outstanding order and deliver the prepared one; if the siren starts before that delivery, it must be silenced first. No food slip is currently demanding an immediate recovery.
u26: A prepared order is waiting to be handed over, a separate order has been taken but not yet prepared, and the siren is ringing. The siren must be switched off before the prepared food is served, since serving during a ring would fail the task. Then the agent must prepare the outstanding order and complete both deliveries.
u27: A prepared order is waiting to be handed over, a separate order has been taken but not yet prepared, and food has just slipped. The very next step must restore food to the agent's hands. After recovering it, the agent must prepare the outstanding order and serve the prepared one, taking care to silence any siren before a handover.
u28: A prepared order is waiting to be handed over, a separate order has been taken but not yet prepared, food has just slipped, and the siren is ringing. The next step must recover the fallen food, and the siren must be switched off before any serving. After that, the agent must prepare the outstanding order and complete the deliveries without serving while the alarm is on.
u29: A prepared order is waiting to be handed over, an order has been taken but not yet prepared, and a newly arrived client still needs their order taken. The agent must take the waiting order, fetch and prepare food for the taken order, and serve the prepared food. If a ring begins before that serving, the siren must be switched off first.
u3: A client's order has been taken and the client is still waiting; the order has not yet been prepared. The agent needs to obtain food if necessary, prepare it at the stove, and then serve it, making sure the siren is silent at the moment of serving.
u30: A prepared order is waiting to be handed over, an order has been taken but not yet prepared, a newly arrived client still needs their order taken, and the siren is ringing. Switch the siren off before any serving; serving while it rings would fail the task. Then take the waiting order, fetch and prepare food for the taken order, and complete the deliveries.
u31: A prepared order is waiting to be handed over, an order has been taken but not yet prepared, a newly arrived client still needs their order taken, and food has just slipped. The very next step must leave the agent holding food again. After recovering it, the agent must take the waiting order, prepare food for the taken order, and serve the prepared food; any later siren must be silenced before a handover.
u32: A prepared order is waiting to be handed over, an order has been taken but not yet prepared, a newly arrived client still needs their order taken, food has just slipped, and the siren is ringing. The very next step must recover the fallen food, and the siren must be switched off before any serving. After that, the agent must take the waiting order, fetch and prepare food for the taken order, and complete the deliveries without serving while the alarm sounds.
u4: An order has been taken and the client is waiting, while the siren is also ringing. The siren must be switched off, and the taken order still needs food obtained and prepared; the meal may not be served until the siren is silent.
u5: An order has reached the prepared stage but has not yet been served. The agent must complete the service to the waiting client, making sure the siren is silent at the moment the food is handed over.
u6: An order has reached the prepared stage but has not yet been served, and the siren is ringing. Switch the siren off before completing the handover; serving while the siren rings is forbidden.
u7: The food has just slipped out of the agent's hands and must be picked up again on the very next step. This recovery takes priority over all other shop business; failing to retake the food immediately breaks a mandatory requirement.
u8: The food has just slipped and must be recovered on the very next step. The siren is also ringing and must be switched off, but the immediate pickup must happen first; only after the food is back in hand should the agent go silence the siren.
u9: An order has been taken and still needs preparation, while the food has just slipped. The agent must pick the food up on the very next step, then go on to prepare the taken order and serve the waiting client with the siren silent at service time.
